item.title: A DIFFERENT MAN
item.description:
A 2024 film directed by Aaron Schimberg, this is a film capable of changing its nature just like its protagonist. The story centres on Edward, an aspiring actor suffering from neurofibromatosis, a condition that has caused him to have a facial deformity and which seems to be the greatest obstacle of his life.

Edward finds it difficult to relate to other people as he speaks in a low voice, averts his gaze, walks slowly and seems to constantly feel as though he is being watched. His career never seems to take off either and the few jobs he manages to get appear to be linked solely to his appearance and his mental prison.

item.title: POMPO: THE CINÉPHILE
item.description:
‘Cinema is the most direct way to compete with God.’

Without meaning to, Fellini managed to sum up what this film is all about in a single sentence. The dream of an aspiring director turns into a passionate ode to the seventh art, told with the heart of someone who loves it deeply and the mind of someone who knows how to question it. Between surreal comedy and a structure that manages to alternate between comedy and drama, the viewer finds themselves immersed in a meta-cinematic film that shows the process of making a film, starting from dreams and ending with the birth of the work.
